rationale: All seven original findings resolved. CR-001/CR-002: both endpoints now carry Depends(authenticate). CR-003: permission-aware Assistant.get_by_ids used when user present. CR-004: response.json() wrapped in try/except. CR-005: delete_run is a single atomic DELETE WHERE with row-count discrimination. CR-006: 60s TTL in-memory cache active on the authenticated hot path after removing the incorrect user-is-None gate. CR-007: empty/whitespace tokens filtered from status comma-split. No new blocking findings introduced. NF-002 (class-level dict race) is accepted — the worst case is a duplicate ES call, not data corruption, and the simpler fix is appropriate at this scale.
